$comment: Reviewed exceptions for scripts/qa/state-coverage.ts. ignore: not a state a route must reach (key = <Board>, <Board>.<prop> or <Board>.<value>). demoOnly: the state is proven on a demo route (/dev/ui/...) and the reason says why real data is not needed or not possible yet. deferred: the board is in this phase but the state ships later ({phase, reason}); it is not counted while docs/qa/phase.txt < phase and is due from that phase on. Persona S 'banner' and the real 401/429 paths are @state (phase-01 plan §12.3); V3Nav play/learn/profile, the palette and the shortcuts dialog are also reached on real routes by e2e/specs/shell.spec.ts; everything else in P1 is @demo with a reason here.

ignore.V3FlowMap: Reference board: the route map and navigation graph. It has no route (allocation.md row 284).

demoOnly.V3Nav.play: Also real (shell.spec.ts #1); /dev/ui/shell?current=play holds it for the device projects and the dark-theme check.
demoOnly.V3Nav.learn: Also real (shell.spec.ts #3 on /legends); /dev/ui/shell?current=legends holds it for the device projects.
demoOnly.V3Nav.profile: Also real (shell.spec.ts #4 on the legacy /profile inside the shell); Profile v3 is built in P10.
demoOnly.V3CommandPalette.open: The palette is a shell overlay; its content does not depend on account data (shell.spec.ts covers it on /play too).
demoOnly.V3CommandPalette.closed: Closed is the shell's resting state; no data involved.
demoOnly.V3iPhoneToasts.default: Toast placement above the iPhone action bar, on /dev/ui/sections/overlays at iPhone size.
demoOnly.V3iPadPToasts.default: Toast placement on iPad portrait, on /dev/ui/sections/overlays at iPad size.
demoOnly.V3PaymentFailed.last_day: Needs a past_due period ending within 36 h; /dev/ui/shell?user=payment_last_day (persona payment_last_day exists for manual checks).
demoOnly.V3PaymentFailed.expired: Needs an on_hold period that ended; /dev/ui/shell?user=payment_expired (persona payment_expired exists for manual checks).
demoOnly.V3Skeletons.game: Loading skeletons are transient; /dev/ui/skeletons?variant=game holds them still.
demoOnly.V3EmptyStates.default: Pattern specimen on /dev/ui/sections/controls (axe and the visual baseline); real empty states arrive with each phase's lists.
demoOnly.V3SessionExpired.signing_in: Transient state between 'Sign In Again' and Clerk's page; /dev/ui/data holds it.

V3Nav.home.reason: Home ships in P5. The P1 nav hides the item (ui/shell.spec.ts asserts no Home link), so there is no state to reach.

V3Nav.train.reason: Train ships in P5. The P1 nav hides the item (ui/shell.spec.ts asserts no Train link).

V3Nav.review.reason: Review ships in P3. The P1 nav hides the item (ui/shell.spec.ts asserts no Review link).

V3Nav.settings.reason: Settings ships in P10. The P1 nav hides the item (ui/shell.spec.ts asserts no Settings link).

V3CommandPalette.ask.reason: Ask mode lights up with the AI coach (allocation §P7 '⌘K Ask works'); the P1 palette has no Ask row (lib/shell/palette.ts).

V3SessionExpired.in_game_refresh.reason: In-game silent refresh is built in P2 with the live game (allocation F8 row).

V3SessionExpired.in_game_ok.reason: In-game silent refresh is built in P2 with the live game (allocation F8 row).
